description: Park Aerospace develops and manufactures advanced composite materials for aerospace structures and also designs and fabricates composite parts, structures, assemblies and low-volume tooling.
P-D Glasseiden GmbH Oschatz processes textile glass fibers into woven fabrics, mats and other reinforcements. Its listed markets include automotive, transport and wind power.
Plasmatreat supplies atmospheric plasma surface preparation systems for aerospace composite panels and aircraft structures before bonding or coating.
Polynt supplies composite resins and thermoset compounds, including glass- and carbon-fiber reinforced SMC and BMC for automotive and aircraft applications.
SAERTEX develops multiaxial carbon fiber fabrics and composite reinforcements for aerospace applications, including engine cowlings and turbine components.
SHD Composites supplies advanced composite prepreg materials for aerospace manufacturing and aircraft structures.
Sigmatex develops and manufactures carbon fiber textiles for composite applications in aerospace and other sectors.
Scott Bader supplies composite resins and structural bonding solutions used to make lightweight automotive parts.
Saint-Gobain Advanced Ceramic Composites develops fused quartz fibers, ceramic filaments and oxide ceramic matrix composites for aerospace and industrial applications.
Re:Build Manufacturing develops aerospace-grade composite manufacturing processes, including autoclave, out-of-autoclave and filament winding methods.
Roctool provides induction-based heat-and-cool molding technologies for composite materials and automotive components.
